mission: Red-team target acquisition/persistence on the NEWEST lawfully acquired footage in datasets/pickleball/registry.json with usable rights that was not used in prior target evals.
verdictStatement: No registry footage can lawfully AND validly be used for a fresh target-acquisition red-team right now. The only usable-rights footage in the registry (8 fresh-candidate clips, added 2026-08-29, none used in any prior target eval) is a registry-declared LABEL-BLIND holdout pool: creating the target-identity ground truth a red-team eval requires (who is who, true track ids, switch/false-lock adjudications) is exactly the labeling the registry prohibits before the freeze, and red-teaming + fixing against these clips would tune the system on the repo's only fresh holdout, destroying its holdout value. Independently, even a label-free run is impossible on this box: TA replay consumes pose PeopleFiles produced by ApplePoseProvider (macOS-only); datasets/corpus/runs/ does not exist on Linux and no Linux pose extractor exists in the repo (BLOCKED_EXTERNAL component).

sources.whyUnusableForTargetEval: Still-image object-detection datasets, registered_not_downloaded, commercialTrainingClearance=not_cleared (undocumented provenance). No temporal footage, so no target persistence can be evaluated.

evaluatedButExcluded.whyUnusableForTargetEval: No distributable temporal media with usable rights: youtube segment metadata without media, video frames without redistribution rights, code/model-weights only, CC BY-NC-SA tabular data (noncommercial term), tabular-only CC BY with no media present, and one non-retrievable dataset claim.

quarantinedUnknownRights.whyUnusableForTargetEval: All are quarantined_not_downloaded, excluded_noncommercial, duplicate edits, or quarantined_never_eligible_license_laundering_risk. None has media in the repo; none has cleared rights.

freshCandidates.addedAt: 2026-08-29 (newest acquisitions in the registry; acquired by wave-c/c16 and wave-d2/d2-03)
freshCandidates.rights: 6x CC BY 3.0 (YouTube page-verified 'reuse allowed'), 2x public domain (VOA-produced). Rights ARE usable (store/analyze/annotate/train/commercial with attribution or PD).
freshCandidates.policyBar: Registry freshCandidates.policy: 'role=fresh_candidate, label-blind holdout pool; excluded from datasets/corpus and from all splits/training until a future freeze registers them through the acquisition front door.' Per-item notes: 'No labels of any kind exist or may be created for this clip before the freeze.'
freshCandidates.whyUnusableForTargetEval: A target red-team requires target-identity ground truth (true track ids, switch/false-lock adjudication) — that is label creation, which the registry prohibits pre-freeze. Using the pool to find-and-fix tracker bugs would additionally tune against the only fresh holdout footage, contaminating the planned freeze. Precedent: d3-11 ran only a mechanical label-free OOD gate over these clips and created no labels.

priorTargetEvalScopeCheck.taBenchCases: datasets/ta-bench/cases.json: 301 cases over 12 (recordingId, sessionKey) pairs, all datasets/corpus recordings (dvids/afn/wm sessions). Zero references to any fresh-candidate id (verified programmatically).
priorTargetEvalScopeCheck.d3-01-rt-target: Prior TA red-team (wave-d3/d3-01) used SYNTHETIC fixtures only.
priorTargetEvalScopeCheck.freshCandidateReuseAudit: grep of every fresh-candidate id across the repo: only acquisition summaries (c16, d2-03), the d2-09 integrity report, and the d3-11 label-free OOD-gate run reference them. None was used in a target eval.

technicalBlockCheck.replayInput: packages/swing-lab/src/engine/taReplay.ts + targetAcquisitionBench.ts loadRun() require <corpus>/runs/<recordingId>/people.json pose files.
technicalBlockCheck.runsDirOnLinux: datasets/corpus/runs/ does not exist in the checkout (verified 2026-08-29).
technicalBlockCheck.poseExtraction: Pose PeopleFiles are produced by ApplePoseProvider (macOS/Apple Vision only, per d3-01 and repo docs). No Linux pose extractor exists in ml/ or tools/ (person-capable detectors there are paddle-bench object detectors, not pose).
technicalBlockCheck.consequence: Even a label-free hazard-signal run (identityContests, followJumps) on fresh footage is BLOCKED_EXTERNAL on this environment: it needs a Mac to extract pose, and would still be policy-questionable on label-blind holdout.

dataIntegrityMeasurements.method: Mechanical (label-free) verification of the fresh-candidate pool at commit time.
dataIntegrityMeasurements.sha256: 8/8 files byte-match the registry media.sha256 values.
dataIntegrityMeasurements.directoryContents: fresh-candidates/ holds exactly the 8 registered mp4 files; zero sidecar/label files.
dataIntegrityMeasurements.crossReferences: 0 fresh-candidate ids in ta-bench cases.json, corpus sources.json, recordings.json, splits.json.

deliverables.regressionFixture: packages/swing-lab/test/e08FreshHoldoutGuard.test.ts — 5 tests pinning the label-blind boundary: labelBlind flags, exact directory contents (no label sidecars can appear), per-file sha256 byte-match (no silent replacement of holdout footage), zero ta-bench references, zero corpus/split references. Any pre-freeze contamination of the fresh holdout now fails CI.

heldOutCases: wm-dink-01 and afn-vic-rally1 were not viewed, labeled, tuned against, or regenerated.
unblockPath: 1) Run the planned acquisition freeze: register fresh candidates through the front door (corpus sources/recordings/splits) with session-level grouping.
2) On a Mac, extract pose runs (people.json/scenes.json) for the newly registered recordings.
3) Only then propose + human-verify TA cases on the new sessions and run the red-team replay (identity switches, false locks, reacquisition) against them as a true one-shot holdout.

gates.tests: 5 new e08FreshHoldoutGuard tests green in every run. Full swing-lab suite: 463/468 green with 1 flaky failure in the PRE-EXISTING test/oodGateRedTeam.test.ts (untouched by this workstream): its ffmpeg fixture builds exceed vitest's 5000ms testTimeout under load on this Linux box (a different case times out each run; the same file also times out on a clean base-branch worktree, and passes 8/8 when run in isolation on this branch).
